overview.description: The Vanguard Morningstar Small-Cap ETF (VB) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Morningstar US Small Cap TR USD index. The fund seeks to track a market-cap-weighted portfolio that provides small-cap exposure to the US equity space. VB was launched on Jan 26, 2004 and is issued by Vanguard.
